decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The proposed development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Location Plan - PP-14873383v1Location and Block Plan  - AR-012 Rev. 01Proposed Floor & Roof Plan - AR-121 Rev. 01Other documents submitted with the applicationPlanning StatementHighways proformaFlood risk AssessmentReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes Order) 1 September 2020 (as Amended), the development shall only be used as a Residential Parent Assessment Unit / Residential Family Centre within Use Class C2 and for no other purpose whatsoever without express planning permission first being obtained from the Local Authority.Reason: In the interests of residential amenity, car parking and highway safety.

The development hereby permitted shall be occupied by no more than 6 residents / 2 families and 3 members of staff (excluding ad hoc visiting specialists/ therapists) at any one time, in line with the following occupancy levels:  (1 child + 1 parent) per time, (2 children + 1 parent) per time or (1 child + 2 parents) per time.Reason: To minimize the impact of the development on the occupiers of neighbouring properties and to ensure that car parking provision complies with the Council's adopted standards.

Details of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste shall be provided within the development in pursuance of the Residential Parent Assessment Unit / Residential Family Centre hereby approved and in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). This shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The development shall not be occupied until details of the required cycle parking spaces have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.These details should demonstrate:Location: Near entrances or main access,Design: StandsSecurity: Secure, overlooked, well-lit,Full enclosed: 4 walls and a roof,Accessibility: 1.2m wide, Step-free, no obstructions.The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the details stated above prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to conform to Enfield DMD policy 45 and promote sustainable modes of transport.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C2 (residential institution), with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
